description: 遊び場・防災広場等 [fire, police and emergency services and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 目黒区. 目黒区内の遊び場、防災広場等の一覧. Coverage: 目黒区. The portal files it under the publisher 目黒区. Its tags are 位置情報, 遊び場, 防災広場. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
